dedupe_keys.name: checkmynet lu open data crowdsourced internet speed and quality tests with location ilr luxembourg

description: Checkmynet.lu is the Luxembourg Institute of Regulation's tool for testing the speed and quality of internet connections. It is independent, crowdsourced and open source, runs on Android, iOS and web browsers, and tests more than 150 parameters for speed, quality of service, quality of experience and net neutrality. Results are shown on a map with filters and are published as open data: test results with download and upload speed, latency, operator, equipment and GPS coordinates, through a documented API and as monthly CSV downloads. The data.public.lu listing marks the data as updated continuously, with the resource links last refreshed in June 2025. Coverage: Luxembourg, fixed and mobile connections, with results located where the user allows it. Format and access: open data API and monthly CSV files, free under CC BY. Caveats: tests are self-selected and depend on user equipment and wifi; locations may be approximate or missing; the start date of the archive and file sizes were not checked. Simulation uses: measured speed and latency distributions by operator and place for Luxembourg service models, and a check on declared coverage. Related records: the ILR RGDR coverage extracts give declared coverage; the RTR NetTest open data for Austria and the CTU NetTest open data for Czechia come from similar open-source measurement systems.
name: checkmynet.lu open data: crowdsourced internet speed and quality tests with location (ILR Luxembourg)
